courtyard.title: Courtyard
courtyard.content: The public-facing, external spaces of the temple (such as comment sections, social media feeds, or public message boards). This is in contrast to the parts of the temple you pay to access.

drop.title: Drop
drop.content: Any piece of gated content. This includes public content released under specific conditions or digital products accessible only to those who have made an offering.

enter.title: Enter
enter.content: The transition from passive observer to active participant. This occurs when you stop browsing and officially engage with the business, whether through a purchase or another formal channel.

flame.title: Flame
flame.content: Time and energy spent creating digital products and content.

gate.title: Gate
gate.content: A barrier to entry. This can be a paywall, a password-protected area, or a section that requires a specific action to be completed before access is granted.

Gate of Intent.title: Gate of Intent
Gate of Intent.content: A specialized gate that records a declaration of intent from those who cross it. Unlike a standard ‘Join’ or ‘Contact Me’ button, it requires both an offering and a written declaration before interaction begins. It serves as a qualitative filter to ensure that those who enter are doing so with deliberate focus rather than passive curiosity.

god.title: Gods
god.content: Fictional characters within the myth that represent higher forces outside the direct control of the priest.

intent.title: Intent
intent.content: The specific motivation or reason for entering. It reflects the principle that participants approach the temple of their own volition rather than being targeted by traditional marketing.

knock.title: Knock
knock.content: The act of showing up at a gate to request access.

kormusic.title: KorMusic
kormusic.content: The system of music practice developed by Michael Korman (the priest).

myth.title: Myth
myth.content: The overarching narrative of the temple. It encompasses the internal history of the project as well as the experiences and stories of everyone who interacts with it.

offering.title: Offering
offering.content: Used in the temple the way most businesses would say 'price', 'payment', or 'fee'. A fixed cost for specific access or items; not a donation.

Pillar of Stones.title: Pillar of Stones
Pillar of Stones.content: A progress marker for collective goals. As offerings are made, the stones light up. Each stone represents a specific financial milestone requirement.

priest.title: Priest
priest.content: The creator and administrator of the temple. The individual responsible for the content, the rules, and the management of the business.

rite.title: Rite
rite.content: An online course or structured educational program provided within the temple.

ritual.title: Ritual
ritual.content: The ongoing stream of content and media produced by the temple.

temple.title: Temple
temple.content: The entire business and ecosystem. This refers to the total project, including the website, products, and all social media.
